clue.text: Mockery made of exposed Tsar with flag

clue.text: Simply quitting band recording needless routine

clue.text: Tiny egg blini cooked by the Parisian

clue.text: Rabble-rousing society linked to publication

parts.note: an edition is an issue of a publication

clue.text: Estimation primarily of (22/7n + 10n)
